given.note: A5-22's card for the pack Alex wants to buy ('The card is typed on the page'): the page entry calls K-09 v1.3 takeMoneyBefore alone, stage card, step A5-22, keep false (a card typed for a pack keeps no saved card row from this stage: K-32 default 15), whose stripe_save_card effect is eff-alex-hot-flow-card (tool-api/fixtures/j5-buy-pack-page.json's cardEffectId), and keeps it with the step's option. It reads the card save by K-14 v1 pageIntent on the studio's own account: it needs a card, so the answer carries the client secret and the account for Stripe's form only (README default 69). Nothing is charged here: the pack is charged at the buy, on its own yes. The client secret and the account id are placeholders.
